shouts.name: Aura Whisper
shouts.text: Your Voice is not a Shout, but a whisper, revealing the life forces of any and all.

shouts.name: Battle Fury
shouts.text: Your Thu'um enchants your nearby allies' weapons, allowing them to attack faster.

shouts.name: Become Ethereal
shouts.text: Your Thu'um reaches out to the Void, changing your form to one that cannot harm, or be harmed.

shouts.name: Bend Will
shouts.text: Your Voice bends the very stones to your will. As it gains power, animals, people and even dragons must do your bidding.

shouts.name: Call Dragon
shouts.text: Odahviing! Hear my Voice and come forth. I summon you in my time of need.

shouts.name: Call of Valor
shouts.text: The valiant of Sovngarde hear your Voice, and journey beyond space and time to lend aid.

shouts.name: Clear Skies
shouts.text: Skyrim itself yields before the Thu'um, as you clear away fog and inclement weather.

shouts.name: Cyclone
shouts.text: Your Thu'um creates a whirling cyclone that sows chaos among your enemies.

shouts.name: Disarm
shouts.text: Your Thu'um defies steel, as you rip the weapon from an opponent's grasp.

shouts.name: Dismay
shouts.text: And the weak shall fear the Thu'um, and flee in terror.

shouts.name: Dragon Aspect
shouts.text: Once a day, take on the mighty aspect of a dragon, delivering colossal blows, with an armored hide, and more powerful shouts.

shouts.name: Dragonrend
shouts.text: Your Voice lashes out at a dragon's very soul, forcing the beast to land.

shouts.name: Drain Vitality
shouts.text: Your Thu'um reaches out and steals the very lifeforce of your enemies.

shouts.name: Elemental Fury
shouts.text: The Thu'um imbues you with the power of the elements, enhancing melee attacks.

shouts.name: Fire Breath
shouts.text: Inhale air, exhale flame, and behold the Thu'um as a blazing inferno.

shouts.name: Frost Breath
shouts.text: Your breath is winter, your Thu'um a blizzard.

shouts.name: Ice Form
shouts.text: Your Thu'um is ice, and so are those unfortunate ones who tease your wrath.

shouts.name: Kyne's Peace
shouts.text: Your Thu'um calls forth the grace of Mother Kyne herself, calming animals and filling your body with strength...

shouts.name: Marked for Death
shouts.text: Speak, and let your Voice herald doom, as an opponent's armor and lifeforce wither in a trice.

shouts.name: Miasmic Breath
shouts.text: Your voice is death, behold as your opponents decay.

shouts.name: Phantom Form
shouts.text: Conjures a spectral facade to act as a decoy.

shouts.name: Plague Breath
shouts.text: Your breath is toxic, you Thu'um a plague.

shouts.name: Predator's Might
shouts.text: Your Thu'um commands nature itself to come to your aid and fills your heart with the power of a dire predator.

shouts.name: Slow Time
shouts.text: Shout at time, and command it to obey, as the world around you stands still.

shouts.name: Soul Tear
shouts.text: Your Thu'um cuts through flesh and shatters soul, commanding the will of the fallen.

shouts.name: Static Roar
shouts.text: Your Thu'um projects into a powerful surge of electricity that lingers on damaged foes.

shouts.name: Storm Call
shouts.text: A Shout to the skies, a cry to the clouds, that awakens the destructive force of Skyrim's lightning.

shouts.name: Summon Durnehviir
shouts.text: Durnehviir! Hear my Voice and come forth from the Soul Cairn. I summon you in my time of need.

shouts.name: Throw Voice
shouts.text: The Thu'um is heard, but its source unknown, fooling those into seeking it out.

shouts.name: Unrelenting Force
shouts.text: Your Voice is raw power, pushing aside anything - or anyone - who stands in your path.

shouts.name: Whirlwind Sprint
shouts.text: The Thu'um rushes forward, carrying you in its wake with the speed of a tempest.
